map.鞣制铬吸收率 使用指南: Chrome Absorption Rate in Tanning — User Guide
map.输入鞣液初始铬浓度、废液铬浓度及皮重、液比，计算铬吸收率与铬吸收量，帮助优化鞣制: Enter initial and spent chrome concentrations, hide weight, and float ratio to compute chrome absorption rate and amount—optimizing tanning, raising chrome utilization, and cutting chrome-laden effluent and cost.
map.按鞣制前后浴液铬浓度差计算铬吸收率，评估铬鞣效率与化工材料利用率。: Compute chrome absorption rate from the bath concentration difference before/after tanning; assess chrome-tanning efficiency and chemical utilization.
map.按液量与浓度差算出被皮吸收的铬质量，用于物料衡算。: From liquid volume and concentration difference, compute chrome mass absorbed by the hide for material balance.
map.通过提碱、升温等手段提高吸收率，降低废液铬污染与处理成本。: Raise absorption via basification, heating, etc., cutting effluent chrome pollution and treatment cost.
map.：铬吸收率(%) = (初始浓度 − 废液浓度) ÷ 初始浓度 × 100%；液: : chrome absorption rate (%) = (initial − spent concentration) ÷ initial concentration × 100%; liquid volume (L) = hide weight × float ratio; chrome absorbed (kg) = (initial − spent) × volume ÷ 1,000,000 (concentration in mg/L). Grades: ≥80% excellent, ≥60% good, ≥40% fair, else poor.

map.常用手段包括后期提碱（提高 pH 促进铬络合）、适当升温、延长鞣制时间与减小液比: Common means: late basification (raise pH to promote chrome complexation), moderate heating, longer tanning, and smaller float; higher absorption cuts cost and effluent chrome together.
map.吸收量为什么要除以一百万？: Why divide the absorbed amount by one million?
map.浓度以 mg/L 计、液量以 L 计，相乘得 mg；除以 10⁶ 即换算为 kg: Concentration in mg/L times volume in L gives mg; dividing by 10⁶ converts to kg (1 kg = 10⁶ mg), so the formula is concentration difference × volume / 10⁶.
